name: Sunray Sequoia 4-Person Infrared Indoor Sauna 400K
description: Description Indulge in the soothing warmth of the SunRay Sequoia 4-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna, crafted from premium Canadian red cedar that fills the air with a natural, calming aroma. Designed with 10 advanced carbon-nano heaters, the Sequoia quickly reaches up to 140°F, delivering deep, even heat with low EMF levels. Its spacious square cabin includes movable ergonomic backrests, chromatherapy lighting, recessed interior and exterior lights, and a Bluetooth speaker system for the ultimate at-home spa experience. Easy to assemble and built to last, the Sequoia blends comfort, performance, and timeless beauty. Features Comfortably accommodates up to 4 people Constructed from rich Canadian red cedar wood for durability and natural aroma 10 carbon-nano infrared heaters for fast, even heat distribution Reaches temperatures up to 140°F for therapeutic wellness benefits Supports a Low-EMF sauna setup Movable ergonomic backrests provide personalized comfort Chromatherapy mood lighting enhances relaxation Oxygen ionization system purifies the air inside the cabin Recessed interior and exterior lighting plus LED reading lamp Bluetooth speaker system and cup holders for convenience Dual LED control panels allow easy adjustments inside or outside Ventilation system supports fresh airflow Tempered glass door for added style and safety ETL/CSA certified for safety and reliability Simple assembly with adult setup required What's Included?
